text: I use Ritmo every single day and love it, but when a phone call comes in halfway through an exercise, everything I had answered is gone when I come back 😤 happened three times now. Version 1.0.1, on a Xiaomi with Android.
the breathing timer restarts from zero every time I check a text mid-session. super frustrating, kind of defeats the point of a calm app :( iphone 14, app version 1.1.0
still losing my exercise answers when I switch to another app for a moment… I thought this was fixed already?? I'm on the 1.2.0 beta
Since a few days my phone gets warm and the battery drains a lot overnight, and Ritmo shows as the top consumer in battery settings. I'm on 1.1.0 on a Pixel 7.
